data.name: AccountHasProtectedEmails
data.value: The mail account {0} still holds {1} emails within their legal retention period or on legal hold, so it cannot be deleted. Disable it instead; it can be deleted once nothing is kept any more.

data.name: AccountRetentionHelp
data.value: Empty = organization default. A longer or shorter period applies to emails archived from now on; stored retention dates are never shortened.

data.name: ActiveHelp
data.value: Active (users of an inactive organization cannot sign in; archiving continues)

data.name: AdminPasswordTooShort
data.value: The admin password must have at least 12 characters.

data.name: AllowProviderAccess
data.value: Allow support access by the service provider

data.name: AllowProviderAccessHelp
data.value: While allowed, the provider's admins can open this organization's archive for support. Every access, with its reason, is written to this organization's audit log.

data.name: AuditorRoleDescription
data.value: Can read and export every mail account of the organization, e.g. for a tax audit, but change nothing.

data.name: AutoPurgeExpired
data.value: Delete emails automatically when their retention has expired

data.name: AutoPurgeExpiredHelp
data.value: Required by data protection law for personal data that no longer has to be kept. The original's chain entry stays as proof of the deletion.

data.name: CreateAdminHelp
data.value: Create an additional admin, e.g. when the organization's admins are locked out. This is recorded in the organization's audit log.

data.name: DefaultOrganizationStaysActive
data.value: The default organization cannot be deactivated.

data.name: DeleteRefusedLegalHold
data.value: The email is on legal hold (itself, its mail account or the organization) and cannot be deleted.

data.name: DeleteRefusedRetention
data.value: The email is still within its legal retention period and cannot be deleted.

data.name: DomainsHelp
data.value: Comma separated. Users signing in via OIDC with an address of these domains are created in this organization.

data.name: FirstAdminHelp
data.value: The organization's own admin, who manages its users, mail accounts and retention. Leave empty to add admins later or let them sign in via OIDC.

data.name: LegalHoldOrganization
data.value: Legal hold for the whole organization (nothing is deleted)

data.name: LegalHoldReasonRequired
data.value: Please give a reason for the legal hold.

data.name: NoAnchors
data.value: No anchors yet; they are created daily.

data.name: NoOrganization
data.value: Your user does not belong to an organization.

data.name: NoOriginalLegacy
data.value: This email was archived before originals were kept; it is sealed, but there is no original file.

data.name: OrganizationSettingsOwnedByCustomer
data.value: Retention, legal hold and support access are set by the organization's own admins.

data.name: OrganizationsIntro
data.value: Each organization is a separate archive: its users never see another organization's data. Provider admins see names and counts here, but no content.

data.name: OriginalHashMismatch
data.value: The stored original does not match its SHA-256. Run an integrity verification.

data.name: OriginalPurged
data.value: The original was deleted after its retention period.

data.name: ProtectedEmailsKept

data.value: Delete {0} emails whose retention has expired? This cannot be undone.

data.name: PurgedExpired
data.value: {0} emails with expired retention were deleted.

data.name: RetentionCannotBeShortened
data.value: A retention period can be extended but not shortened.

data.name: RetentionYearsHelp
data.value: Counted from the end of the calendar year of the email (§ 147 AO). Commercial letters: 6 years, accounting vouchers: 8 years, books and records: 10 years. 0 = no retention obligation. Applies to emails archived from now on; stored retention dates are never shortened.

data.name: RetentionYearsRange
data.value: The retention must be between 0 and 100 years.

data.name: RetentionYearsShortHelp
data.value: From the end of the calendar year (§ 147 AO); 0 = none.

data.name: Sha256Seal
data.value: SHA-256 seal of the stored fields

data.name: SlugHelp
data.value: Lower case letters, digits and hyphens; used in storage paths and cannot be changed later.

data.name: SlugTaken

data.name: SupportAccessExplanation

data.value: The organization has not allowed support access.
